checklist_templates_window_ck.name: checklist_templates_window_ck
checklist_templates_window_ck.value: "checklist_templates"."schedule" = 'event' or ("checklist_templates"."opens_at" is not null and "checklist_templates"."due_at" is not null)

recipe_change_requests_kind_ck.name: recipe_change_requests_kind_ck
recipe_change_requests_kind_ck.value: ("recipe_change_requests"."kind" = 'change' and "recipe_change_requests"."product_id" is not null) or ("recipe_change_requests"."kind" = 'new' and "recipe_change_requests"."proposed" is not null)

supplier_entries_kind_ck.name: supplier_entries_kind_ck
supplier_entries_kind_ck.value: ("supplier_entries"."kind" = 'borc' and "supplier_entries"."cost_mode" is not null and "supplier_entries"."method" is null and "supplier_entries"."cash_out_id" is null) or ("supplier_entries"."kind" = 'odeme' and "supplier_entries"."method" is not null and "supplier_entries"."cost_mode" is null and "supplier_entries"."invoice_id" is null and "supplier_entries"."due_date" is null and "supplier_entries"."category_id" is null)

supplier_entries_gider_ck.name: supplier_entries_gider_ck
supplier_entries_gider_ck.value: "supplier_entries"."cost_mode" is distinct from 'gider' or "supplier_entries"."category_id" is not null or "supplier_entries"."invoice_id" is not null
